## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **Standard Deduction:** The standard deduction is a fixed dollar amount that reduces the total income subject to federal income tax. Instead of keeping every receipt for medical expenses or charitable donations (itemized deductions), taxpayers can subtract this single flat amount from their taxable earnings. When the IRS raises standard deduction thresholds for inflation, it lowers overall tax bills, allowing workers to keep more of their paycheck before income tax applies. [[The Tribune-Democrat]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5) [[WLFI]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNSWlDeGc4VlFmM0V4a2IwNzlXdTNtZ3JRSkY4ckFjSWVteDUwalJCZXljYlZWQVBhdVQ0VGZiSmR3Zi0zc0RFSXZrYml6VzlJaTlZczBURldYZ0lsbHZERmx0Y2pOSUdyLXgwNlJ3YzltczJ5eEtZeXNVR3ZvNUxIamVJbmY0VFFYQm54VWEyUFFxRno5TkVNMmFOSnBFMDlvM3FXblFUTGREdllfM004?oc=5) [[CNBC]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/2027-zero-percent-capital-gains-tax.html)
